regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation (45% of themes trend-eligible) with AI Infrastructure (SMH) and US Energy Complex (XLE) as clear top two by score, both trend-eligible and uncrowded; breadth of the leader is only 0.125 (weak cohesion) while Energy's breadth is 0.636 (broad participation). No one-narrative regime: AI leads on sustained momentum but Energy is a credible, broad challenger with the top durability bar. The validated edge is drawdown-control only (gate_helps true), so leans are expressed as cautious conditional direction on lasting leadership, not return forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed handoff from AI Infrastructure to US Energy Complex: the rotation margin (0.185) is thin, and Energy holds the higher durability bar and much broader breadth. The watch condition is Energy's score overtaking AI Infrastructure's score AND remaining trend-eligible for 5 consecutive sessions while AI Infrastructure's breadth stays below 0.2 — that would retire the AI-leadership watch and put Energy as the new dominant trend.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is trend-eligible with the broadest participation of any top theme (breadth 0.636) plus the highest durability bar (0.62), indicating staying power across constituents rather than a single-stock squeeze. It is the confirmed challenger (score 1.375, margin to leader only 0.185) in a narrowing rotation, and its crowding_z of 0.93 is below the crowded flag, so this is a trend-following continuation lean rather than a crowded-fade.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0, so the rank-2 reading is an attention lens not a return signal; a narrow, news-driven energy pop (unscheduled_share 0.75 in macro flow) can reverse sharply via mean-reversion in commodities.

falsifier.text: XLE underperforms SPY by more than 5% over any 10-session window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure remains the top-ranked theme by score and is trend-eligible, but its leader position carries a breadth of only 0.125, meaning the leadership is concentrated in very few names rather than broad participation. The lean is for the trend-state continuation (still eligible, uncrowded at z=0.15), while acknowledging this is the dominant narrative that could hand off if the broad Energy leg keeps strengthening.
evidence: crowding_z 0.15, crowded false — not a size-down flag
one_narrative false — not an everything-into-AI regime
theses.dissent: Leader breadth of 0.125 is dangerously narrow — a handful of crowded AI-infra names carrying the theme means any rotation in those few stocks would collapse leadership even without a macro catalyst.

falsifier.text: SMH loses its trend-gate eligibility (durability bar drops below its gate threshold) at any point before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is trend-eligible and carries a 'trend' hurst tag with high durability (0.75, second-best among eligible themes) and solid breadth (0.6). It is the strongest of the software themes and is the only crowded top theme (crowding_z 1.61), which per the detector contract is a size-down caution, not a fade — so the lean is to maintain the trend-following direction while flagging the crowding as a reason to be cautious on magnitude.
evidence: crowding_z 1.61, crowded true — valid only as a size-down caution per guardrails
theses.dissent: crowding_z 1.61 is the highest among top themes, and the guardrails note thematic inflows often mark tops; a reflexive unwind in a crowded, retail-heavy cybersecurity ETF could compress quickly.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms SPY by more than 8% over any 15-session window before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
